name: The Aquidneck Club
architects: Donald Steel and Tom Mackenzie (opened 2000 as the Carnegie Abbey Club; renamed The Aquidneck Club after its members bought it)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, tile x31y461, project RI_Statewide_D22 (2022 Rhode Island statewide lidar), published 2024-01-26, UTM 19N NAD83, NAVD88 m; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow (release data-aquidneck), clipped to the world + 100 m with pipeline/intake.py raster

laz.source: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud, project RI_Statewide_D22 (2022 Rhode Island statewide lidar), 2,500-ft tiles in NAD83(2011) / Rhode Island (ftUS), NAVD88 ftUS; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow (release data-aquidneck) from rockyweb.usgs.gov and clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py laz --classes 1 (the project has no vegetation classes: 1 unclassified, 2 ground, 7 noise, 17 bridge deck, 18 high noise); flown spring 2022 (leaf-off); returns more than 45 m above the ground dropped (max_height_m: birds and wires)
laz.label: 2022 USGS Rhode Island statewide lidar

world.note: OSM course boundary (way 325263047) bbox 1,139 x 1,801 m in UTM 19N + scenery, whole 256 m chunks, centred: 1,536 m east-west (199 m each side), 2,048 m north-south (the 2,048 m limit: 123 m south and north)

scorecard_source: GolfPass (golfpass.com/courses/28943-the-aquidneck-club/scorecard-and-layout), read 2026-10-31: seven sets per hole (Gold, Gold/Green, Green, Green/White, White, Yellow, Red), par 71, men's and women's stroke index (column handicap_w); every row adds up to the tee table's totals. Men's ratings from the same table (Gold 72.5/132, Green 70.6/128). OpenGolfAPI (from OSM) has the same Gold row and men's index. 18Birdies has the same Gold row and totals but a different men's stroke index (open item). Unverified: the club publishes no card. Built: Gold (the tips) and Green (one step forward; the card has no Blue; developer, 2026-10-30). Other sets in scorecard.csv, not built.
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (RI_Statewide_D22, 2022 Rhode Island statewide lidar)
Photo for checking: USDA NAIP via the USGS National Map
notes: Course chat, 2026-10-31 (developer asleep, standing defaults and the developer's overnight calls): every penalty area red, OSM boundary as OB, driving range OB, trees from lidar, Gold + Green built with Green the default, wind 2-12 mph (Narragansett Bay shore). Theme newport (the same island and the same coastal mix of pine, maple and oak; Newport Country Club's theme).
range_art_note: the practice ground (the boundary's southern lobe) is out of bounds; drawn as rough with OB stakes so it does not look playable (as at Oregon Golf Club and Meadow Club)
red_water_osm_note: natural=water/wetland inside the boundary with no golf tag, which played as rough: the pond between the 17th tees and green (w208859700) and the wetland at (610, 1309) local (w940801562); red penalty areas (standing default); Narragansett Bay (sea, from the coastline, propose_sea.py)
